text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: sudden increase in cont-batch latency and KV cache evictions on prod-region-us-east-1. Error rate rising for /v1/generate. Auto-escalation to oncall (Devon) triggered.
Devon: I'm on it, joining. Seeing 5xx spike and token latency up ~3x. Paging logs now.
Ana (runtime): I can see continuous-batch queues spiking and many small seqs are being packed into huge batches due to `max_batch_tokens` being incorrectly set on the new rollout. KV cache size climbed from 20GB->160GB in 10m.
Sasha (eng-ml): Is this the new quantized model rollout that changed sequence heuristics?
Ana (runtime): Yep, config diff at 09:17 shows `max_batch_tokens: 65536` (bad) instead of expected `8192`. Also `max_num_seqs` defaulted to 512 when under memory pressure we expect 64.
Mike (eng-sre): Noted. Do we have an immediate mitigation we can apply without full rollback?
Ana (runtime): We can PATCH the cluster config to clamp `max_batch_tokens` to 4096 and `max_num_seqs` to 96 per backend. That should stop the runaway batching and reduce KV cache growth.
Devon: Priya, can you surface any customer-facing symptoms? Which customers are seeing errors?
Priya (support): Support dashboard: 8 paid customers showing 5xx and timeouts, majority on streaming endpoints. A few reports about truncated responses. I'll prepare a customer impact note.
Girish: Any automated fallbacks configured? Can requests hit a smaller model variant?
Ana (runtime): Smart routing is enabled but fallback thresholds haven't tripped because requests are still being accepted; they're just stalling in runtime. We need to reduce batch depth so requests complete.
deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.15-reroute-01 detected to infra group; no automated rollback.
Devon: OK perform the hotpatch. Ana, Mike - coordinate. Put a temporary 2 min maintenance note if we need to throttle.
Ana (runtime): Patching config now across the affected pool. Command:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap cont-batch-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_tokens":"4096","max_num_seqs":"96","batch_timeout_ms":"60"}}'
```
Ana (runtime): Pushed patch to us-east-1 pools. Rolling restart of 3 nodes scheduled.
Mike (eng-sre): I'm adding a temporary outbound rate limit to reduce incoming concurrency:
```
sh /ops/limit-traffic.sh --svc inference-us-east --rps 8000
```
Sasha (eng-ml): Also lowering `batch_timeout_ms` from 200 -> 60 should prevent extremely long waits that grow KV cache occupancy.
Devon: Monitoring metrics now. Key signals: 95p latency, KV cache bytes, continuous-batch queue depth, 5xx rate.
Ana (runtime): 30s after patch: KV cache growth flattened. Eviction rate dropped 90%. 95p latency trending down.
Priya (support): Customer note draft: "We experienced elevated errors and delayed responses due to internal batching config. Mitigation applied; some requests may have been retried. We're monitoring and will follow up." Approving to send to impacted accounts?
Girish: Send a short alert and offer follow-up postmortem. Keep legal/cust-sec in CC.
Devon: Priya send the note, tag customers with high impact. I'll keep the channel updated.
Priya (support): Sent initial message to impacted customers and opened support cases for the 8 accounts.
Mike (eng-sre): Post-patch checks at +10m: 5xx rate back to baseline for all but 1 heavy tenant doing very long prefix prompts. We're throttling that tenant to protect cluster while they investigate.
Ana (runtime): For the long-term fix: we should add a config guard that validates `max_batch_tokens` and `max_num_seqs` against model memory profiles during canary rollouts, plus a hard upper bound in runtime. Filing issue.
Sasha (eng-ml): Also adding an eval that simulates heavy short-seq traffic to ensure the batching heuristics don't expand batches incorrectly.
Devon: Oncall handoff: I'm logging this as Sev-2. I'll start the incident doc. Who will own the RCA? Ana + Sasha + Mike?
Ana (runtime): Happy to co-own RCA with Sasha. Mike can own the infra remediation and rollout safety.
Devon: Locking in actions: (1) Hotpatch applied and validated (Devon/Ana/Mike) :white_check_mark:, (2) Customer notifications sent (Priya) :white_check_mark:, (3) Throttle for heavy tenant (Mike) :white_check_mark:, (4) Config guards + canary checks (Ana/Sasha) TODO, (5) Postmortem timeline + follow-ups (Devon).
IncidentBot: Incident marker updated: status -> mitigated, severity -> S2, runbook start -> 1873456789.
Girish: One more ask — please capture the exact config diff and upload to the incident doc.
Ana (runtime): Pasted diff in the incident doc and added the exact kubectl commands and output for reproducibility.
Devon: I'll keep the channel open for 1h for follow-ups then move to postmortem thread. Thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
Priya (support): Adding post-incident customer follow-up template to the doc.
Mike (eng-sre): Final note: Add alert thresholds for KV cache delta > 50%/5m and batch_queue_depth > 2k so we catch this earlier.
Sasha (eng-ml): Also let's gate config changes with a linting step in CI that rejects obviously insane values.
Devon: Agreed. Closing active mitigation. We'll reconvene in the RCA.
Ana (runtime): Copy. Closing out operational actions.
IncidentBot: Thread archived for follow-up.
